name: beto-pokedex
description: A fullstack Pokedex built with React and Express

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
